messages:
Olivia Chen: Final check for ModelServe v1.2 social launch. Primary goals: webinar signups, demo requests, and inbound lead capture. Publish window: Tue 10:00 PT. Need X thread (6 tweets), 2 LinkedIn posts (company + founder), and 3 image posts.

Jamal Reed: Confirm UTMs before publish: utm_campaign=msv1_2_launch, utm_source=social, utm_content={slot}. Landing page must map leads to MKT_LAUNCH_LINKEDIN for LinkedIn and MKT_SOCIAL_INBOUND for X replies.

Sara Patel: Design can deliver 3 hero images + story vertical by EOD tomorrow. Need overlay text in two lengths: short (<=55 chars) and long (<=140 chars). Alt text included.

Alex Gomez: Draft X thread below. Will queue scheduling once landing link final.

Alex Gomez: Tweet 1: ModelServe v1.2 is live  Faster kernels, smarter routing, lower inference cost. Join our launch webinar: [link]
Tweet 2: Production apps need predictable latency + cost. v1.2 adds smarter batching and KV caching.
Tweet 3: Highlights: up to 3x throughput (workload dependent); 15-30% lower token costs with quantization.
Tweet 4: Ops features: canary rollouts, per-route SLOs, automatic fallback to cheaper model variants.
Tweet 5: We'll share benchmark slides and a test-config repo during the webinar.
Tweet 6: Register for live Q&A (APAC session included): [webinar link] #ModelServe #LLMinfra #RedwoodInference

Olivia Chen: Legal requested "workload dependent" qualifier added. Also add APAC note in at least two posts.

Maria Liu: Lead routing checklist: landing form -> SFDC web-to-lead with campaign mapping. Default lead owner -> MKT_QUAL. Social DM demo requests -> create Zendesk ticket tag=social-demo and notify #sales-inbound. APAC leads -> apac-sdr-group.

Alex Gomez: Reply templates for social ops (short):
- Demo ask: "Thanks! We'd love to show you ModelServe 1.2  can I DM a link to pick a 15-min slot?"
- Webinar signup: "Thanks for registering! Calendar invite coming. Any topics you'd like covered?"
- Benchmarks ask: "We'll share slides in the webinar. Want early access? Drop an email and we'll send the deck."

Sara Patel: CTA buttons on images: "Register" and "Request demo". Uploading assets to Figma: /ModelServe/LaunchAssets (will add light/dark variants).

DesignBot: Files uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/example/modelserve-launch (mock link). Alt text added.

Jamal Reed: Landing page & short link ready: https://rwd.in/msv1-2 (placeholder). Will confirm SFDC mapping once published.

Olivia Chen: Owners: Alex = scheduling + thread, Sara = assets, Maria = tracking + routing, Jamal = landing page & legal, Olivia = approvals. Please mark done here once complete. Publish when legal OKs claims and landing link is final. :rocket:
